coverage_notes: This import selects national contracts and direct-purchase exports where available, plus separate subsequent-contract exports for 2016-2018. It does not include every resource family exposed by each annual package.

Coverage by source period: 2007-2011 annual contracts; 2012-2015 semester contracts; 2016 semester contracts and subsequent contracts; 2017-2018 quarterly contracts (subsequent contracts are available for 2017 and 2018 Q1); 2019-2025 quarterly contracts and direct purchases.

Catalog resource families not yet imported include initiation notices, contract amendments, dynamic purchasing system notices, annual procurement plans, and other ancillary reports. These should be cataloged separately before joining.

The 2022 Q2 direct-purchase CSV contains a second contracts header followed by six appended contract records. The importer stops at that second header; the separate catalog contracts resource is imported independently.

Legacy CSVs have inconsistent delimiters and encodings. Multi-line text was flattened during parsing, overflow delimiters in long free-text cells were normalized, and invalid bytes in one legacy Windows-encoded source were replaced. Review these records before high-stakes or definitive analysis.
